messages.speaker: client
messages.text: My old account is closed but its username is unavailable. Can I wait for it to become reusable?

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: Hello, I'm Mira. Used usernames stay permanently reserved after closure and can never be reused. Choose a different username for the new account.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: So waiting for it is unnecessary?

messages.speaker: operator
messages.text: For the new registration, choose a different username. Can I help with anything else? Goodbye!

references.text: Used usernames remain permanently reserved after account closure and can never be reused. A new registration must use a different username. Reports download at Documents > Reports > PDF. Report filenames are editable by the user. For a missing public report, support can open a technical ticket immediately and collect the app version later; version is not required to create the ticket. In version 4, refresh missing reports with Refresh Reports; only version 5 has a Report Repair button. Do not prescribe a version-specific fix without first learning the version. To investigate a missing public instrument listing, the support ticket must contain its exact ticker; do not claim to have submitted that investigation without it. These generic technical and navigation requests do not require account identity verification. Public bonds are under Markets > Bonds. The coupon calendar is under Markets > Coupons. Do not charge privately for support.
references.provenance: Fictional diagnostic policy, NOT Freedom policy
